description: This file defines the PhpBackend class, a PHP cache implementation for Drupal, which stores cache items in PHP files utilizing PHP's opcode cache for performance. It includes methods for retrieving, storing, invalidating, and deleting cache items, as well as handling cache tags and checksum validation.

classes.name: PhpBackend
classes.description: A PHP cache backend implementation that stores cache items in PHP files, leveraging PHP's opcode cache for performance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a PhpBackend object with cache bin, checksum provider, and time service.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by cache ID, normalizing the ID and optionally allowing invalid/expired items.

methods.name: getByHash
methods.description: Fetches a cache item using its hashed cache ID, including the PHP file and preparing the item.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple cache items at once.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items by their IDs, returning an array of items.

methods.name: prepareItem
methods.description: Prepares a cache item for use, checking expiration and validity based on tags and checksum.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a cache item with ID, data, expiration, and tags.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache item by cache ID.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by cache ID.

methods.name: invalidateByHash
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by its hashed cache ID.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates all cache items, deprecated in favor of deleteAll.

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Placeholder for garbage collection, currently empty.

methods.name: removeBin
methods.description: Clears the cache and deletes all stored cache files.

methods.name: writeItem
methods.description: Writes a cache item to PHP storage as a PHP file with serialized data.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the PHP storage object.

methods.name: normalizeCid
methods.description: Normalizes a cache ID using base64 hashing.
